fileShare.title: Share “{{name}}”
fileShare.description: They get this file's own key, never its folder's. They see only this file.
fileShare.recipientHint: A Kutup address (user@server) or, for someone on this server, their email. Someone on another server gets an invite link, and can edit too, through their server, if you allow it.
fileShare.canEditHint: Editors can change it and save versions; viewers can only open it. Only you can rename, move or delete it.
fileShare.note: To change what someone can do, or remove them, use the menu on their row below.
fileShare.notFound: No one with that address. For another Kutup server use user@server.
fileShare.failed: The file could not be shared.
fileShare.loadFailed: Could not load who has access.
fileShare.empty: Only people who can open its folder can open this file.
fileShare.confirmBody: They lose access now, and the file moves to a new key they never get: nothing changed from now on is readable to them. What they already opened or downloaded stays with them.
fileShare.changed: Who has access changed meanwhile. Check the list and try again.
fileShare.removeFailed: Access could not be removed. Try again.
fileShare.alreadyHas: They already have this file. Only its owner can change what they can do.
fileShare.editorsCanShareHint: People who can edit may share it with others (they cannot remove anyone).
fileShare.onlyOwnerRemoves: Only the owner can change or remove people.
fileShare.settingFailed: The setting could not be saved.
fileShare.linksHint: Anyone with a link can open and download this file, without an account. The key is in the link itself; the server never sees it.
fileShare.linkFailed: The link could not be made.
fileShare.confirmLinkBody: The link stops working now, and the file moves to a new key the link never gets. Anyone who already downloaded it keeps their copy.
fileShare.onlyOwnerAcross: Only the file's owner can share it with other servers.
fileShare.inviteBody: They are on another Kutup server: they add it under Shared with me. It works only for them.
fileShare.recipientChanged: {{account}} has reset their account. Remove them, then share again if you want to.
fileShare.roleFailed: That could not be changed. Try again.
fileShare.otherServerFixed: For people on other servers this is set by their invite: remove them and share again to change it.

storage.label: Storage used
storage.title: Storage
storage.open: Storage: {{used}} of {{total}} used. Show what fills it
storage.unavailable: Storage details could not be loaded.
storage.shared: Shared by Drive, Photos, Office, Maps and Chat.

uploads.title: Uploads

failure.shareQuota: This shared folder's upload limit is reached.
failure.notSameFile: That is not the same file. Choose the one this upload started with.
failure.folderKeyChanged: The folder moved to a new key since this upload started. Upload the file again.
failure.expired: The server no longer has this upload (it waited over a day). Upload the file again.

uploads.reconnecting: Waiting for the connection; it goes on from where it stopped.
uploads.interruptedHint: Choose the same file again to go on from where it stopped.
uploads.unreadable: An upload into a folder that moved to a new key

conflict.title: “{{name}}” is already here
conflict.fileThere: {{folder}} already has a file with this name. Names are compared without letter case.
conflict.folderThere: {{folder}} already has a folder with this name. Names are compared without letter case.
conflict.replaceHint: Replace: the file there goes to the trash, where you can restore it.
conflict.keepBothHint: Keep both: this one is uploaded as “{{name}}”.
conflict.applyToAll: Do the same for the other name clashes in this upload
